description: The OD-06 RTO is the primary Regional Transport Office for the Dhenkanal district in Odisha, responsible for vehicle registration, licensing, and road safety enforcement. It transitioned from the legacy prefix OR-06 in 2012 and serves as a major administrative hub for the central industrial and agricultural region of the state.
address: Regional Transport Office, Near College Chowk, Dhenkanal, Odisha
